name: Interlock-bypass supervision
summary: Indicates that a separately controlled interlock bypass is active in the monitored scheme.
description: Indicates that a separately controlled interlock bypass is active in the monitored scheme. An interlocking function permits or blocks an operation according to the positions and conditions of related equipment. Electrical, mechanical and trapped-key interlocks implement different parts of a coordinated operating philosophy.

In a switchgear feeder panel, a control diagram can prevent an incompatible combination of breaker, disconnector and earthing-switch positions. The physical equipment documents determine which restrictions are mechanically enforced. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Bypass position feedback” at the input and “Bypass-active alarm” at the output. Bypass indication is not a bypass operating instruction.
